summary: Queue system testing completed. All 12 backend tests passed for the global, rate-aware, fair queue system for audio generation. Frontend integration verified - ScriptEditor correctly shows regeneration UI and context menu. The queue system properly: (1) returns {status:'queued', job_id} immediately on POST regenerate, (2) provides job status polling with queue position via GET /api/jobs/{job_id}, (3) processes jobs sequentially with fair round-robin scheduling, (4) returns complete results with audio_url, duration_seconds, character_name, generated_voice_id, (5) admin queue status endpoint works correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Queue system implementation is well-structured with RateLimiter, FairScheduler, and worker loop
Global rate limiting (RPM=10, RPD=50, TPM=10000) is properly enforced via acquire_gemini_slot/release_gemini_slot
Fair round-robin scheduling ensures no user monopolizes the queue
Retry logic with exponential backoff (5s→10s→20s, max 3 attempts) is correctly implemented
Frontend ScriptEditor.js properly polls for job completion with pollRegenJob function
context_for_next_testing_agent: Queue system for audio regeneration is fully functional. Tests verified: (1) POST /api/script/{episode_id}/dialogue/{index}/regenerate returns queued status with job_id, (2) GET /api/jobs/{job_id} returns status with queue position, (3) Completed jobs include audio_url, duration_seconds, character_name, generated_voice_id, (4) Admin endpoint GET /api/admin-9821/generation/queue shows live_queue and db_queue stats, (5) Published episodes correctly return 423 Locked, (6) No raw 503 errors - all errors are user-friendly. Test episode: ep_2a62619c6f03 (unpublished), ep_71379fe1575a (published).
